correctness.rationale: The local inequality uses three distinct neighbors for n>=3, including the triangle layer at n=3; it requires at least one selected neighbor outside D and at least two inside D. An indexed mask sequence fixes a unique based closed walk, so the trace has no division by n. An exact independent signed-subset determinant computation on all 16 states gives the stated factorization (16 nonzero terms). There is also a small algebraic check: on the ten recurrent states the odd layer-swap sector has determinant 1-tz+t^2 z^3; eliminating unit pivots in the even sector gives (1-tz-t^2 z^3)(1-tz^2-(t^3+t^4)z^4)-2t^3 z^5=(1-tz)Q. The cut bounds give the sharp minimum n; equality forces exactly one crossing edge at each vertex, giving the two layers or the four phases of 0011. In the normalized characteristic factors the nonzero base roots are simple within each factor; roots vanishing at z=0 contribute only from degree n onwards. Direct expansion at 1,-1,i,-i in the quintic gives the four recorded Taylor rows, so summing n-th powers proves the two near-minimum formulas even at n=3. For even n a full layer plus an adjacent pair in the other layer witnesses positivity at n+2, establishing the internal gap and non-unimodality.
residual_risks: The replay checks the finite polynomial determinant; the trace bijection and coefficient extraction prove the all-n statement. Formal terms at n=1,2 are not simple prism counts.
